official.deadline_note: ANU publishes no closing date: the scholarship page lists the application period as 'Open for applications', and ANU's scholarship directory lists this award with status 'Open for applications'. There is nothing to file by a fixed date because there is no separate scholarship application - eligible students are considered automatically with their admission application.
official.status_note: ANU's scholarship page states 'Application period: Open for applications' with no closing date, and ANU's Find a scholarship directory lists this award as 'Open for applications' with 'Automatic consideration'.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Published wording: 'Value: 20% off your first-year tuition fees.' and 'The value of the Award is stated in the letter of offer. The duration of the Award is one year, with the tuition scholarship applied towards tuition at the start of each semester.' Recipients remain liable for the balance: 'The recipient is responsible for making payment of all tuition fees by the prescribed date as set out by the University each session.'
official.funding_period: percent off first-year tuition fees (one year)
benefits: The duration of the Award is one year, with the tuition scholarship applied towards tuition at the start of each semester.
There is no need to apply for the scholarship. All eligible students applying for admission to commence at the university will be automatically considered.
You will need to accept both your academic offer and your scholarship offer separately.
A recipient of the Award is permitted to hold concurrent student financial awards as outlined in the ANU scholarships, grants and bursaries procedure.
eligibility: is a new commencing student or a continuing student who has received an offer of admission to a higher AQF level of studies;

holds residential status in one of the following Countries or Regions: China (including Taiwan, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR), Japan, Mongolia, Republic of Korea, or The Democratic People's Republic of Korea;

meets the minimum academic entry requirements: undergraduate applicants a Selection Rank of 85 (or equivalent as determined by the University) or above, or postgraduate applicants a minimum GPA of 5.5 (or equivalent);
is not the recipient of an external sponsorship that covers all or part of the student's tuition fees at the University;

acknowledges that the award can be offered only once at each level of study, except where an applicant progresses from an undergraduate degree (AQF Level 7) to a one-year Honours program (AQF Level 8), or accepts a packaged offer (e.g., a Graduate Certificate leading to a Master's degree).
requirements: There is no need to apply for the scholarship. All eligible students applying for admission to commence at the university will be automatically considered.
Press the 'Apply now' button to start the Admissions application process.
You will need to accept both your academic offer and your scholarship offer separately; more information is provided with your scholarship offer letter.
The recipient is responsible for making payment of all tuition fees by the prescribed date as set out by the University each session.
The value of the Award is stated in the letter of offer.
documents: No separate scholarship application or document is required; consideration is automatic with the admissions application.
The ANU admission application itself, started from the 'Apply now' button on the scholarship page.
The scholarship offer letter, which states the value of the Award and must be accepted separately from the academic offer.
selection_criteria: Only applicants who meet all the eligibility criteria will be considered.
Selection is made based on academic merit.
Qualifications submitted for admission to the University will be converted to the common scale, which will determine whether an applicant is eligible for the Award.
Eligible applicants with multiple qualifications will be ranked according to the qualification used as the basis of admission.
The University reserves the right to make no award where it considers there is no applicant of sufficient merit.
coverage: 20% off first-year tuition fees, applied towards tuition at the start of each semester of the one award year.
The recipient is responsible for making payment of all tuition fees by the prescribed date as set out by the University each session.
Recipients of the Award are responsible for the costs of books, study materials, accommodation and all other costs of study.
It is the recipient's responsibility to obtain residential accommodation.
application_method: Choose an eligible ANU undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program; the Doctor of Medicine and Surgery (MChD) and the Master of Digital Transformation and Entrepreneurship (MDTE) are excluded.
Press the 'Apply now' button on the scholarship page to start the ANU Admissions application process.
Submit the admission application; there is no separate scholarship application and all eligible students are considered automatically.
If selected, receive a separate scholarship offer letter stating the value of the Award and accept it separately from the academic offer.
Pay your share of the tuition fees by the prescribed date set out by the University each session; the tuition scholarship is applied towards tuition at the start of each semester.
official.application_route: No separate scholarship application: submit an admission application to an eligible ANU coursework program via the 'Apply now' button, be considered automatically on academic merit, then accept the academic offer and the separate scholarship offer individually.
official.citizenship_residency: Holds residential status in one of the following Countries or Regions: China (including Taiwan, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR), Japan, Mongolia, Republic of Korea, or The Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Eligibility is by residential status, not citizenship.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the award is restricted to international students who hold residential status in the listed countries or regions.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Any eligible ANU undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program, EXCEPT the Doctor of Medicine and Surgery (MChD) and the Master of Digital Transformation and Entrepreneurship (MDTE).
official.duration: One year - payments are made for a fixed number of years, and payment is made for 1 year.
official.description: The Australian National University (ANU) may offer a number of awards known as the ANU Vice-Chancellor's International Achievement Award; the objective of the Award is to attract a diverse range of academically capable overseas students to enrol in undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programs offered by the University. Funding for this Award is provided by the Australian National University, and the Award is made contingent on the University's confirmed funding allocations. The Award is worth 20% off first-year tuition fees, applied towards tuition at the start of each semester of the one award year.
official.program_type: Academic coursework scholarship, university-funded (tuition fee reduction)

verification.notes: Read the official ANU scholarship page and its linked Conditions of Award (63/2026) PDF, and cross-checked the award's status on ANU's Find a scholarship directory: value (20% off first-year tuition fees), one-year duration, per-semester application, eligibility country list, entry thresholds, automatic consideration, and cessation/deferral rules all confirmed. No monetary amount, currency, English requirement, or closing date is published.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a 20% discount on your first year of tuition, not a living scholarship: ANU credits it against tuition at the start of each semester and you still owe the other 80% plus every other cost yourself. There is no separate scholarship application - if you are eligible and you apply for admission to an eligible ANU coursework program, you are considered automatically, so the real deadline is your admission intake. The decisive filter is residence, not citizenship: this version is only for applicants resident in China (including Taiwan, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR), Japan, Mongolia, the Republic of Korea or the DPRK, and anyone already sponsored for their ANU tuition is excluded. Because it runs for a single year, you must be able to fund the remaining tuition from year two onward, plus books, accommodation and living costs, from your own resources.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving international applicants resident in China (incl. Taiwan, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR), Japan, Mongolia, or the two Koreas with a Selection Rank of 85+ (undergraduate) or GPA 5.5+ (postgraduate) who are not externally sponsored for their ANU tuition and can self-fund the balance.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your residential status is on the five-item country/region list before you rely on this award; applicants from everywhere else belong in the separate ANU International Achievement Award.
Check your intended program is not the MChD or the MDTE, the two published exclusions.
Submit the ANU admission application as early as you can for your target intake - consideration is automatic, so an early application is the only lever you control.
Watch your email closely for the separate scholarship offer and accept it in addition to your academic offer; missing it forfeits the discount with no re-offer.
Have liquid funds ready for the remaining tuition invoice by ANU's prescribed due date each session.
Line up Canberra accommodation before you travel - ANU states housing is the recipient's responsibility, not part of the award.
common_rejection_risks: Falling below the entry bar (Selection Rank 85 for undergraduate, GPA 5.5 for postgraduate) - assessment is automatic, so there is no window to argue your case.
Holding external sponsorship that covers any part of your ANU tuition, which is an outright exclusion.
Enrolling in MChD or MDTE, the two programs expressly excluded from the field of study.
Being resident outside the listed countries and regions, which routes you to a different ANU award entirely.
Accepting the academic offer but never accepting the separately issued scholarship offer.
Holding two concurrent ANU academic or sports scholarships, which the Conditions list as a trigger for cessation.
Providing incorrect or misleading information in the admission application, on which ANU may withdraw the award at any stage.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining 80% of first-year tuition (ANU international coursework fees run into the tens of thousands of AUD), the full tuition fee for every subsequent year of a multi-year program, books and study materials, Canberra accommodation, student services and amenities fees, and all day-to-day living costs.
document_audit: There is no scholarship-specific document to upload - do not wait for an application window that does not exist, and do not send scholarship documents unsolicited.
Your admission application must carry transcripts that ANU can convert to its common scale; if you submit several qualifications only the one used as your basis of admission is used for ranking.
The scholarship offer letter is a distinct document stating the award value and needs its own formal acceptance, separate from your academic offer - keep both together.
Nothing in the award requires referees, interviews or a research proposal, so any effort spent preparing those is wasted.
alerts: ANU can make no award at all if it judges no applicant is of sufficient merit, and the award is contingent on the University's confirmed funding allocations - an offer of admission does not guarantee the discount.
The award cannot be deferred; if you defer your studies you should assume it is lost.
It covers one year only, so a multi-year program faces a full-fee cliff from year two - build that into your student visa financial evidence.
If you enrol part-time, ANU treats the award as taxable income, and it may affect Centrelink payments.
As a recipient you may be asked to take part in ANU publicity, including interviews and photographs, and ANU may publish recipient names.
The award carries no commitment by the University for future employment.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: You apply only for admission (ANU Admissions, via the 'Apply now' button), ANU assesses eligibility automatically on academic merit, then issues an academic offer and a separate scholarship offer stating the value, each of which must be accepted individually; the discount is credited against tuition at the start of each semester.
